name: Basher
tagline: Auto-approve Claude Code bash prompts on your Mac
description: Basher is a Mac app that answers Claude Code bash permission prompts for you, so long agent runs do not stop to ask. Notarized by Apple; runs on Intel and Apple Silicon (macOS 13+).

screenshots.alt: The Basher menu: every Claude session with its own on/off switch, and a master switch to pause Basher
